'''Helena Bonciani Nader''' (born November 5, 1947) is a Brazilian biomedical scientist based at the [[Federal University of São Paulo]]. She served as president of the [[Brazilian Society for the Advancement of Science]] from 2011 to 2017. She works in [[glycobiology]], specialising in the characterisation of [[proteoglycan]]s. She is a member of [[The World Academy of Sciences]].

== Early life and education ==
Nader was born in [[São Paulo]], to a family of [[Syrian Brazilians|Syrian]], [[Lebanese Brazilians|Lebanese]] and [[Italian Brazilians|Italian]] descent.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://euraxess.ec.europa.eu/worldwide/brazil/interview-helena-nader-researcher-and-president-brazilian-society-advancement|title=Interview with Helena Nader, researcher and president of the Brazilian Society for the Advancement of Science (SBPC)|date=2015-03-08|website=EURAXESS|access-date=2019-03-12}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Helena Nader: A ciência brasileira ainda não reflete o nosso povo |url=https://revistapesquisa.fapesp.br/helena-nader-a-ciencia-brasileira-ainda-nao-reflete-o-nosso-povo/ |access-date=2024-09-30 |website=revistapesquisa.fapesp.br |language=pt-br}}</ref> She spent her childhood in [[São Paulo]] and [[Curitiba]].<ref name="abc.org.br">{{Cite web|url=http://www.abc.org.br/2019/03/08/em-8-de-marco-homenageamos-helena-nader-mae-mulher-pesquisadora-e-defensora-da-ciencia-brasileira/|title=Em 8 de março, homenageamos Helena Nader: mãe, mulher, pesquisadora e defensora da ciência brasileira – ABC|language=pt-BR|access-date=2019-03-12}}</ref> She was a high school student in the [[United States]]. She studied biomedical sciences at the [[Federal University of São Paulo]] and graduated with a [[bachelor's degree]] in 1970.<ref name=":0" /> She simultaneously earned a bachelor's degree in education at the [[University of São Paulo]], before beginning her doctoral studies in molecular biology. She was supervised by [[Carl Von Peter Dietrich]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=http://www.unifesp.br/eventos-anteriores/item/1655-helena-nader|title=Helena Nader|last=Fagundes|first=Ana Carolina|website=www.unifesp.br|language=pt-br|access-date=2019-03-12}}</ref> Nader earned a doctorate at the [[Federal University of São Paulo]] in 1974.<ref name=":0" /> She was a postdoctoral researcher at the [[University of Southern California]].

== Research and career ==
Nader returned to the [[Federal University of São Paulo]], where she was made a professor in 1989.<ref name=":1" /> Nader studies [[glycobiology]], investigating [[proteoglycan]]s, a complex class of glycoconjugates.<ref name=":0" /> She studies how [[proteoglycan]]s such as [[heparan sulfate]] are involved in [[hemostasis]].<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=http://www.iea.usp.br/pessoas/pasta-pessoah/helena-bonciani-nader|title=Helena Bonciani Nader — IEA USP|website=www.iea.usp.br|access-date=2019-03-12}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Nader|first1=Helena B.|last2=Sampaio|first2=Lucia O.|last3=Cavalheiro|first3=Renan P.|last4=Jarrouge|first4=Thais R.|last5=Regatieri|first5=Caio V.|last6=Dreyfuss|first6=Juliana L.|date=September 2009|title=Heparan sulfate proteoglycans: structure, protein interactions and cell signaling|journal=Anais da Academia Brasileira de Ciências|volume=81|issue=3|pages=409–429|doi=10.1590/S0001-37652009000300007|pmid=19722012|issn=0001-3765|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Colburn|first1=P.|last2=Buonassisi|first2=V.|last3=Dietrich|first3=C. P.|last4=Nader|first4=H. B.|date=1987-06-01|title=Heparin sequences in the heparan sulfate chains of an endothelial cell proteoglycan|journal=Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences|volume=84|issue=11|pages=3565–3569|doi=10.1073/pnas.84.11.3565|issn=0027-8424|pmid=2954157|pmc=304915|bibcode=1987PNAS...84.3565N|doi-access=free }}</ref> Her work involves [[nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy]] and fragment analysis.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ww2.icb.usp.br/icb/helena-nader/|title=Helena Nader ministra palestra sobre biologia celular e estrutural no ICB {{!}} Instituto de Ciências Biomédicas {{!}} USP|language=pt-BR|access-date=2019-03-12|archive-date=2019-03-30|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190330205603/https://ww2.icb.usp.br/icb/helena-nader/|url-status=dead}}</ref> She holds visiting professorships at [[Loyola University Medical Center]] and [[The W. Alton Jones Cell Science Center]].<ref name=":2" />

Nader is an advocate for equality, diversity and inclusion in science and engineering.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://revistapesquisa.fapesp.br/2019/03/08/entrevista-helena-nader/|title=Entrevista: Helena Nader|website=revistapesquisa.fapesp.br|language=pt-br|access-date=2019-03-12|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190330211913/http://revistapesquisa.fapesp.br/2019/03/08/entrevista-helena-nader/|archive-date=2019-03-30|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name="abc.org.br"/> She has been a member of the [[Brazilian Society for the Advancement of Science]] since 1969, and took part in resistance to the military dictatorship.<ref name=":1" /> She was appointed president of the [[Brazilian Society for the Advancement of Science]] in 2011.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|url=http://www.anpg.org.br/helena-nader-assume-a-presidencia-da-sbpc/|title=Helena Nader assume a presidência da SBPC|date=2011-02-18|website=ANPG|language=pt-BR|access-date=2019-03-12}}</ref> She was the third woman to hold the position, after [[Carolina Bori]] and [[Glaci Zancan]].<ref name=":4">{{Cite web|url=http://portal.sbpcnet.org.br/noticias/presidente-da-sbpc-por-tres-mandatos-faz-um-balanco-de-sua-gestao/|title=Presidente da SBPC por três mandatos faz um balanço de sua gestão – SBPC|language=pt-BR|access-date=2019-03-12}}</ref> She held the position for three terms, handing over the position in 2017.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":4" /> During her time as president, she encouraged the allocation of oil royalties to science and technology.<ref name=":1" />

On March 29, 2022, she was elected president of the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-03-29 |title='Precisamos de uma revolução na educação', diz 1ª mulher a presidir Academia Brasileira de Ciências |url=https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/ciencia/2022/03/precisamos-de-uma-revolucao-na-educacao-diz-1a-mulher-a-presidir-academia-brasileira-de-ciencias.shtml |access-date=2022-03-30 |website=Folha de S.Paulo |language=pt-BR}}</ref>

* 2005 Honorary Professorship at the [[Federal University of Rio de Janeiro]]<ref name="usp">{{Cite web|url=http://www.iea.usp.br/en/persons/speakers/copy_of_alvaro-de-vasconcelos|title=Helena Nader — en|website=www.iea.usp.br|access-date=2019-03-12}}</ref>
* 2008 Grand Cross Class of the National Order of Scientific Merit<ref name="usp" />
* 2009 President of the [http://www.sbbq.org.br Brazilian Society of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology]<ref name="usp" />
* 2010 Moacyr Álvaro Gold Medal<ref name="usp" />
* 2011-2017 President of the [[Brazilian Society for the Advancement of Science]]<ref name="JC">{{cite news |title=CNPq realiza cerimônia virtual de entrega do Prêmio Almirante Álvaro Alberto para Ciência e Tecnologia |url=http://www.jornaldaciencia.org.br/edicoes/?url=http://jcnoticias.jornaldaciencia.org.br/2-cnpq-realiza-cerimonia-virtual-de-entrega-do-premio-almirante-alvaro-alberto-para-ciencia-e-tecnologia/ |accessdate=25 September 2020 |agency=Journal da Ciência |issue=6496 |publisher=SBPC |date=24 September 2020}}</ref>
* 2013 [[Brazilian Navy]] Merit Medal Tamandaré<ref name="eufaco">{{Cite web|url=http://acienciaqueeufaco.mast.br/index.php/2-uncategorised/80-helena-nader-biologia-biologia-molecular-ciencias-biomedicas.html|title=Helena Nader|website=acienciaqueeufaco.mast.br|access-date=2019-03-12|archive-date=2019-03-30|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190330220724/http://acienciaqueeufaco.mast.br/index.php/2-uncategorised/80-helena-nader-biologia-biologia-molecular-ciencias-biomedicas.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* 2016 Nuclear National Energy Commission, Felippe Sheep Medal<ref name="eufaco" />
* 2018 [http://www.sbbc.org.br Brazilian Society of Cell Biology], Classics in Cell Biology<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bv.fapesp.br/pt/pesquisador/8127/helena-bonciani-nader/|title=Helena Bonciani Nader - Biblioteca Virtual da FAPESP|website=bv.fapesp.br|language=pt-BR|access-date=2019-03-12}}</ref>
* 2018 Federation of Experimental Biology Societies, Science Service Award<ref name="eufaco" />
* 2020 [[Prêmio Almirante Álavaro Alberto|Prêmio Almirante Álvaro Alberto]], CNPq <ref>{{cite news |last1=Marques |first1=Fabricio |title=Helena Nader vence o Prêmio Almirante Álvaro Alberto |url=https://revistapesquisa.fapesp.br/helena-nader-vence-o-premio-almirante-alvaro-alberto/ |accessdate=25 September 2020 |agency=Agência FAPESP |publisher=FAPESP |date=26 March 2020}}</ref>
